title: AI-Powered Psychometric Scale Adaptation: From Manual Expert Iteration to Reproducible LLM-Native Item Generation, Cross-Cultural Adaptation, and Bias Auditing
domain: computational psychometrics / generative psychometrics / psycholinguistics / NLP / item response theory / cross-cultural adaptation
